_readme: WinUtil tweaks passed via -Config (flat list of IDs). 'presets' = which presets pick it by default. 'advanced' items are hidden unless you open Advanced. IDs blocked by lib/Guard.ps1 are refused even if listed here. Reviewed against WinUtil 26.08.19.

items.name: Telemetry off (also sets Defender sample submission to 'never send' - protection stays on)
No auto-installed sponsored apps (Candy Crush etc.)
Block firmware-injected OEM installers (WPBT: Armoury Crate etc. auto-install)
Set non-essential services to Manual
items.breaks: Mobile Hotspot (SharedAccess) and Offline Files get disabled; also sets SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB

items.name: Location tracking off
items.breaks: Apps can't use your location (Weather, Maps, Find my device)

items.name: Explorer folder-type auto discovery off (faster big folders)
Remove Widgets completely (Win11Debloat already disables them)
Hide Home and Gallery in File Explorer
Disk Cleanup + component store cleanup (slow; installed updates can no longer be uninstalled)
Disable Reserved Storage (frees ~7 GB)
items.breaks: Updates can fail when the disk is nearly full

items.name: Remove Microsoft Edge
items.breaks: Edge; links in some apps/widgets; Edge WebView2 stays

items.name: Remove Windows AI components (Copilot, Recall packages)
